NIA attaches Srinagar property linked to LeT terrorist conspiracy

The National Investigation Agency (NIA) on Monday attached a residential property in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. The property is linked to a cross-border terrorist conspiracy case involving the Lashkar-e-Taiba (LeT) outfit and was allegedly used to shelter two Pakistani terrorists.
